[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][b][center][size=4]This Mod changes the five cat skins to different colors of Dragons: [/size][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]**Turqouise**[/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#9900ff]**Purple**[/color][color=#ead1dc][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]**Lilac**[/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#3c78d8][size=4]**Blue**[/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4]
[/size][/color][color=#6aa84f][size=4]**Smaragd**[/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4]

[/size][/color][size=4]For correlation check the picture.[/size][/center][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][b][center][size=4]
As the sitting dogs become the sleeping dragons, they love to sleep a lot, which I feel is lovely![/size][/center][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[b]
[center]

[font=Georgia][size=3][b]-------------[/b][/size][/font] Thanks -------------[/center][/b]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]This is my first Mod! When I installed EveriasArt's Mod[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4467/] "Everia's Dragons"[/url] I saw, that there is no assets for the babies, so I added them for a
few colours (You can get the assets from me). Later I wanted to have
that baby dragon as a dog, so I downloaded TheObscureCat's Mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15448]"Stardew Toothless"[/url] for cats as a guide to create this Mod.
Big Thanks to Everia for the inspiration and Obscure Cat for the guidance!!![/size][size=4]
[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]
